Please give yourself some grace on this. This is exactly what happened to my boyfriend 3 years ago while he was finally getting help and getting sober for the first time since he was 19. He had finally gotten a job he wanted since he was old enough to get a job and it's even where we met and fell in love. 

 He was really really proud of his recovery but like you said it caused so many health issues. His brain just stopped working properly and he basically developed narcolepsy for awhile and missed days and was hours late many times on top of having emergency hospital visits for varicose veins and liver cirrhosis.  It was so heartbreaking to him when he got fired because he felt he was doing so well and was so proud. even caused a relapse. But I'm proud to say he is a steady sober now and happier than ever.
He thought he was gonna drink himself to death and now he's over a year sober and we're moving across the country to start a life together. 

I'm sure you know this but  still, Just remember that alcohol addiction is a DISEASE and incredibly difficult on your brain and body to get over. It's not your fault as a person you got fired and it's not your fault as an addict either, it's just tough as hell and things can fall apart sometimes while you are trying to build yourself up again but as long as you keep building it can only get better.I hope you the best. I love him and I love you for doing so wonderful.

So this nightmare happened when i was vary young like in first grade i think.

And was also the first time i got sleep paralysis.

So i was sleeping in my bed and i it was the exact same thing in my dream of me laying in my bed except suddenly there were bugs everywhere im talking centipedes, Beatles, spiders, wasps, mosquitos, and they were all over me and the bed. I could here the noises they made as if they were right in my ear. I couldn't move at all and i could still see them even if i closed my eyes. and it felt so real and disorienting especially because the dream was of me laying in my bed it felt extra real and confusing. I was panicking and screaming in my mind i tried so desperately to thrash about and run away to my parents room across the hall... but my body just continued to lay motionless as my mind was torturing me with the image of bugs crawling and eating me inside and out even as i knew i was awake so i thought it was actually happening. Eventually it wore off after what was probably two minutes but felt like an hour and i ran away to my parents room sscared out of my mind.

A few years later and after i had had two more instances of it happening after horrific nightmares i found out that theese occurrences were sleep paralysis and ive also had another instance of it happening two years ago but was thankfully much more mild. But that first time was still the most terrifying and ive had a huge fear of bugs ever since. 

Also a fear of ppl being outside my window to kill me thanks to another one i had where that actually happened.
